title: LLM backed Animation of Premade Sprites
author: Simple-Salt-1272
selftext:
Inspired by classic rpg “dialogue portraits”, I’ve been playing around with this system that allows the LLM to select from a selection of premade sprites, one shots, does and more as well as giving it control of the speed of each segment. It can even select an amount of time to pause after each segment. 

It looks a bit rough because this is my test character but I’d love any feedback!

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Super cool!! What are you using for asset gen wise?

replies.author: Simple-Salt-1272
replies.body:
Thank you! I actually just drew these pixel sprites myself. It works like this - there is a sprites folder with folders like tones, one shots, idles, etc. inside those are sub folder like tones/happy which contain a set of premade sprite frames in order of animation.

Available tones, one shots and idles are generated dynamically from a users folder names so people can make and bring their own characters!
